title: Agora 21 Participation Hub
summary: A civic-participation concept exploring how residents could discover an issue, contribute a story, and follow a proposal’s progress. It has not been implemented.

hero.title: Agora 21 Participation Hub
hero.subtitle: A concept for following a civic issue from discovery to participation.
hero.summary: Agora 21 explores how issue explainers, community stories, and proposal updates could fit into one service. It remains a concept and has not been implemented.

overview.title: Make the path from an issue to an action visible
overview.description: The proposed experience introduces a local issue in plain language, gives residents a place to contribute, and shows what could happen next.

solution.title: Discover, contribute, follow
solution.description: These are concept directions for a future service.

steps.title: Discover an issue
steps.description: An explainer would introduce the topic, context, and opportunities to participate.

steps.title: Contribute a perspective
steps.description: A story or response would connect a resident’s experience to the issue.

steps.title: Follow progress
steps.description: A proposal timeline would show milestones and responsible parties.

conclusion.title: Questions for future validation
conclusion.description: Future work would need to test comprehension, participation barriers, accessibility, and expectations about how contributions are used. This concept does not establish adoption or civic outcomes.
